findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "read_declarations_page" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read a home or auto insurance declarations page (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB). Returns the detected product line, the create_quote fields it found, and missin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "premium-lock" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, get_quote, purchase_quote, complete_purchase · Private data: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, create_quote, get_quote, send_checkout_email, purchase_quote, complete_purchase · Public sink: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, create_quote, get_quote, send_checkout_email, purchase_quote, complete_purchase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, get_quote, purchase_quote, complete_purchase · Private data: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, create_quote, get_quote, send_checkout_email, purchase_quote, complete_purchase · Public sink: get_product_catalog, read_declarations_page, create_quote, get_quote, send_checkout_email, purchase_quote, complete_purchase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
